g.title: rule
g.text: • You MAY step on / cross SINGLE yellow lines
• You MAY NOT step on / cross DOUBLE yellow lines
Stanley Rd → Beckett St → cross Accommodation Rd → Beckett St → Nippet Ln → Rider St

g.title: cross1
g.text: Roundabout at Stanley Rd / Beckett St
• Cross where there are NO yellow lines
• Move onto Beckett St (east / cemetery side)

g.title: BS_east
g.text: • You must NOT step on the line
→ Zone is FORBIDDEN to step on line,
but path on pavement is Allowed

g.title: accom_junc
g.text: • There is a crossing point with NO yellow lines

g.title: fail_DY
g.text: Stepped on / crossed a DOUBLE yellow line

g.title: BS_east->fail_DY
g.text: if you step ON the double yellow line

g.title: cross2
g.text: • Cross at point with NO yellow lines
• Move to west side of Beckett St

g.title: Rider_junc
g.text: • Enter via pavement, avoid painted lines
→ Line is Forbidden, pavement path Allowed

g.title: Rider_junc->fail_DY
g.text: if you step ON the double yellow corners

g.title: success
g.text: No double yellow line stepped on or crossed
